title: Couple package '(2 ท่าน)' room is sold twice per slot: each booking takes 1 of capacity 2 and the wizard has no party size
where: packages/modules/booking/src/components/booking-wizard.tsx (no partySize input; createBookingAction defaults partySize 1) + services/availability.ts computeGroupSlots
steps: demo-salon /book?service=couple → pick date/slot → book as customer A; repeat with unrelated customer B same slot
expected: A couple package for 2 people should consume the whole room (party size 2 or capacity=1 room), so the second couple sees the slot full
actual: Both bookings accepted for the same 12:00 slot, each with party_size=1 and price ฿2,990 (for 2 people): 4 people booked into a 2-person couple room
evidence: booking-journey.ts S6 PASS '2026-10-19 12:00: 01a144b6 + 01a144b6'; DB: BK-1015 'คู่รัก หนึ่ง' party_size=1 and BK-1016 'คู่รัก สอง' party_size=1, both starts_at 2026-10-19 05:00Z, service capacity=2 name 'แพ็กเกจคู่รัก 120 นาที (2 ท่าน)'
suggestedFix: Add a per-service 'seats per booking' (default = capacity for room packages) or a party-size selector in the wizard bounded by remaining seats; for the seed, make the couple room capacity 1 resource or partySize 2

title: Abandoned deposit bookings stay 'pending' forever and keep blocking the staff's slots after the QR payment expired
where: packages/modules/booking/src/services/config.ts RELEASED_BOOKING_STATUSES=['cancelled','no_show']; no expiry job anywhere (tooling/worker.ts only runs the outbox; packages/core/src/payments only sets expiresAt)
steps: Book a deposit service (e.g. demo-salon aroma-90) and never pay; wait > payments.expiresMinutes (30 min); query /api/booking/slots for that staff/date
expected: Once the deposit QR expires (or after a grace period) the unpaid pending booking is auto-cancelled / the slot is released for other customers
actual: BK-1001 (demo-salon) created 2026-10-15 15:27Z, payment expired 15:57Z, still status=pending/unpaid 21h later and /api/booking/slots?date=2026-10-17 shows staff ad3925d2bf73 slots 12:30-15:30 BKK available:false
evidence: DB: bookings BK-1001 status=pending payment_status=unpaid, payments.status=pending expires_at=2026-10-15 15:57:16Z; curl -H 'Host: demo-salon.localhost:3000' 'http://localhost:3000/api/booking/slots?date=2026-10-17&service=01a1401b-ad12-7546-8f7f-c6218eab803b&staff=01a1401b-ad75-764e-84ca-ad3925d2bf73' → slots from 05:30Z onwards available:false remaining:0
suggestedFix: Add a sweeper (worker/cron) that cancels pending bookings whose deposit payment expired (cancelledBy='system', reason 'deposit_expired'), or treat pending+expired payment as released in loadAvailabilityData and the exclusion constraint

title: /api/booking/slots and /api/booking/days accept impossible dates (2026-13-99, month 2026-13) with 200 instead of 400

title: Capacity>1 services that require staff (couple massage) never reserve therapist time, so therapists get double-booked and the room is offered when nobody is working
where: packages/modules/booking/src/services/availability.ts isGroupService() (capacity>1 || !requiresStaff) + computeGroupSlots (uses business hours only) + bookings.ts createBooking (group → staffId null); computeStaffSlots only counts bookings with b.staffId === staffId
steps: 1) demo-salon book 'couple' (requires_staff=true, staff linked: แอน/โบว์/มะลิ/น้ำ) Monday 2026-10-19 12:00 (BK-1015, BK-1016 exist). 2) GET /api/booking/slots?date=2026-10-19&service=<thai-60> (any staff)
expected: Couple bookings consume the therapists who perform them (or at least a staff slot), and couple slots are only offered when enough eligible staff are on shift
actual: thai-60 'any staff' at 12:00 Monday still returns remaining=1 (พี่น้ำ free) although two couple sessions run 12:00-14:20; couple slots are offered from 10:00 Monday when only พี่น้ำ works (แอน off Monday, มะลิ/โบว์ start 13:00)
evidence: curl -H 'Host: demo-salon.localhost:3000' 'http://localhost:3000/api/booking/slots?date=2026-10-19&service=01a1401b-ad12-7546-8f7f-bb020e71d441' → '05:00 rem=1, 05:30 rem=1'; DB: BK-1015/BK-1016 staff_id=null starts_at 2026-10-19 05:00Z; services.couple requires_staff=true capacity=2; availability_rules: แอน no weekday 1, มะลิ/โบว์ 13:00-22:00
suggestedFix: Treat requiresStaff && capacity>1 as 'needs N staff': assign staff (or a resource) to group bookings and include them in staff occupancy; restrict group windows to eligible staff schedules instead of business hours

title: Dine-in: paying a stale table-bill QR marks the whole session (including rounds ordered after the bill) as paid - restaurant is short-paid
where: packages/modules/restaurant/src/services/orders.ts onRestaurantOrderPaid (session branch marks every unpaid/pay_at_counter order of the session paid regardless of payment.amount) + table bill flow (QR created once for the due amount at request time, not regenerated)
steps: demo-restaurant /t/<qr A1> → order rounds → ขอบิล → ชำระด้วย PromptPay (QR ฿1,200) → close sheet → order another round (น้ำตะไคร้ใบเตย ฿60) → ขอบิล again → upload slip on the QR panel
expected: After a new round the bill QR is regenerated for the new due amount (or the extra round stays unpaid / due), and a payment smaller than the session total never marks all orders paid
actual: Bill sheet header shows ฿1,260 but the QR panel still charges ฿1,200 with no regenerate button; after the slip the session is 'paid' and all 7 orders including R-1017 (฿60, placed after the bill) are paymentStatus=paid
evidence: bughunt rest-journey2.log 2.8 FAIL 'stale bill: sheet header says "ขอบิลยอดที่ต้องชำระ: ฿1,260" (due ฿1260) but the QR panel still charges ฿1,200'; 2.9 'payment covered ฿1200 of total ฿1260; all orders marked paid: true'; DB table_sessions VF2SR8 status=paid total=126000, payments.amount=120000 paid, orders R-1001..R-1017 all payment_status=paid; screenshot tooling/screenshots/bughunt-storefront_booking_restaurant-rj-fail-01.png
suggestedFix: When an order is added to a bill_requested session, expire/supersede the pending session payment and create a new one for dueTotal; in onRestaurantOrderPaid only mark orders paid up to payment.amount (or only orders placed before payment.createdAt) and leave the session open with the remaining due

title: Table sessions never expire: next-day guests scanning the table QR join yesterday's open session and see/are billed for previous guests' orders
where: packages/modules/restaurant/src/services/tables.ts openOrGetSession/getOpenSessionForTable (returns any 'open'/'bill_requested' session regardless of age; no timeout/auto-close)
steps: Order at table A1 on day 1 and leave without paying/closing (staff forgets to close). On day 2 scan /t/01a14020-a1-w9ntoj
expected: A stale session (e.g. older than a few hours / past closing time / previous business day) is not reused; a new session opens, or at least the guest is warned
actual: Today's scan joined session VF2SR8 opened 2026-10-15 20:27Z with 4 rounds/฿800 from the previous day (R-1001, R-1002...), shown in the table's round history and included in the bill
evidence: rest-journey2.log 2.0 'table A1, session VF2SR8, existing rounds 4, total ฿800'; DB: VF2SR8 orders R-1001 placed 2026-10-15T20:27:21Z, R-1002 2026-10-15T20:27:25Z, then R-1009.. on 2026-10-16
suggestedFix: Auto-close (or ignore) sessions older than N hours or opened before today's opening time; show the opened-at time on the table page; optionally a cron that closes idle sessions

title: Clinic package purchase: PDPA consent checkbox is client-side only - server neither validates nor records it on the patient (patients.consents)
where: apps/web/src/app/(sites)/rw/[tenantId]/packages/[id]/buy/actions.ts:13 schema = { paymentMethod } only; buy-form.tsx:22 <input name=consent required>; services/clinic.ts ensurePatient() creates the patient with consents={}
steps: POST the buy server action without the consent field (or remove 'required' in devtools) → package + patient are created
expected: Server rejects the purchase without consent and stores {treatment/pdpa: {at, version: clinicConfig.consentVersion}} on patients.consents for the newly created HN
actual: Consent value is ignored server-side; patient rows created online carry no consent record although the UI tells the customer they consented (PDPA)
evidence: Code: buy/actions.ts schema z.object({ paymentMethod }) - 'consent' never read; grep 'consents' in services/clinic.ts → no writes (only admin/clinic.ts:156-161 sets consents)

title: Proxy matcher regex has an unescaped dot: any URL whose last segment ends in ico/map/js/css/png/svg/gif/jpg/ttf/otf/mp4/webm skips tenant resolution and 404s (demo-clinic /services/pico is dead)
where: apps/web/src/proxy.ts:7 matcher string "/((?!_next/|favicon.ico|uploads/|.*.(?:png|...|ico|css|js|map|...)$).*)" - inside a normal JS string literal the backslash-dot is just '.', so the lookahead becomes '.*.(?:...ico|js|map...)$' (any char + extension letters)
steps: curl -H 'Host: demo-clinic.localhost:3000' http://localhost:3000/services/pico (linked from the clinic home page, /staff/dr-nicha and /services); also /services/xmap, /products/nodejs
expected: Service page 'Pico Laser' renders (DB: services.slug='pico' active, getServiceBySlug finds it)
actual: 404 with Next's default '404: This page could not be found.' (not the tenant not-found page that /services/nonexistent shows) because the request never gets the /rw/<tenantId> rewrite
evidence: crawl: 'demo-clinic 404 /services/pico (from /) title="404: This page could not be found."'; curl titles: /services/pico, /services/xmap, /products/nodejs → default Next 404, /services/nonexistent → '<title>Lumière Clinic' (tenant 404); node: new RegExp(matcher).test('/services/pico') === false, test('/services/botox') === true; direct getServiceBySlug(tenant clinic, 'pico') returns the row
suggestedFix: Escape properly (String.raw or '\.') so only real file extensions are excluded, e.g. String.raw`/((?!_next/|favicon.ico|uploads/|.*.(?:png|jpg|...)$).*)`; add a test with slugs like 'pico', 'roadmap', 'nodejs'

title: Rescheduling a booking whose deposit is still unpaid shows 'QR ชำระมัดจำหมดอายุแล้ว' on the new booking and leaves the original QR payment pending
where: packages/modules/booking/src/services/bookings.ts rescheduleBooking/createBooking (rescheduleOf → copies answers.paymentId of the OLD booking, creates no payment) + apps/web/.../bookings/[id]/page.tsx:63-66 (payment lookup is by refId=new booking → null → expired card)
steps: demo-salon /book?service=hot-stone → any staff → slot → confirm (pending, QR shown) → เลื่อนนัด → new date/time → confirm
expected: New booking shows a live QR for the deposit (payment moved/re-issued automatically) and the old pending payment is cancelled
actual: New booking BK-1021 page says 'QR ชำระมัดจำหมดอายุแล้ว' with a 'สร้าง QR ใหม่' button (the QR was created seconds earlier and never expired); old payment 01a144c7-5bd9 for cancelled BK-1020 stays status=pending (customer may already have transferred to it)
evidence: book2 script: 'T1 new page: pending=true panel=false expiredCard=true qr=0'; DB: BK-1020 cancelled, payment 01a144c7-5bd9 status=pending amount=30000; BK-1021 only got a payment after pressing สร้าง QR ใหม่; screenshot tooling/screenshots/bughunt-storefront_booking_restaurant-resched-unpaid.png

title: Restaurant cart silently loses lines on reload/new page once the rw_rcart cookie passes ~4 KB (≈20 lines, or a few lines with Thai notes)
where: packages/modules/restaurant/src/components/cart-store.tsx writeCookie (document.cookie with encodeURIComponent JSON; no size check) + services/cart-codec.ts (CART_MAX_LINES=40, note up to 200 chars; each Thai char = 9 bytes URL-encoded)
steps: 390px demo-restaurant /menu: add แกงเขียวหวาน with a 200-char Thai note, then 6 more items with ~190-char notes → bar says 7 รายการ ฿1,090 → reload the page
expected: Cart persists (all 7 lines), or the UI prevents/handles oversize carts (localStorage / server cart / shorter encoding)
actual: After reload the bar shows 'ออเดอร์ของคุณ 2 รายการ รวม ฿540' - the browser rejected every cookie write after the size limit and the cart reverted to the last write that fit; no error shown. Even without notes 20 lines encode to 4,043 bytes (40 allowed)
evidence: rest2 script: 'R2 before reload: bar="ออเดอร์ของคุณ 7 รายการ รวม ฿1,090" cookieLen(doc)=3713' then 'R2 after reload: bar="ออเดอร์ของคุณ 2 รายการ รวม ฿540"'; node size calc: 1 line 205 B, 20 lines 4043 B, 40 lines 8083 B, 10 lines with note 'ไม่ใส่ผักชี' 3233 B
suggestedFix: Persist the cart in localStorage (and pass it to the server in the form body as already done), or store a compact encoding (base64url of a binary/short-key format), cap by bytes and warn the user

title: Reservation zone check ignores reservations without a zone, so zone availability is overstated and tables get overbooked (phone/admin bookings have no zone)
where: packages/modules/restaurant/src/services/reservations.ts checkAvailability: with a zone it counts only reservations.zone = zone (zone-less reservations never counted); admin/reservations.ts:152 stores zone=null when staff leave it blank
steps: Create no-zone reservations for 2026-12-08 12:00 until the whole restaurant is nearly full (14 created), then GET /api/restaurant/reservations/availability?date=2026-12-08&time=12:00&size=2 with and without zone=สวน, then book the garden from /reserve
expected: Zone check also subtracts zone-less reservations that will need a table (garden remaining ≤ overall remaining), and the restaurant can never hold more reservations than tables
actual: Overall: capacity 17, booked 14, remaining 3 - but garden: capacity 4, booked 0, remaining 4; the garden booking RS-1032 was accepted. With the original 12 tables, 12 phone bookings + 4 garden + 8 indoor online bookings would all be accepted (24 for 12 tables)
evidence: rest2 script: 'R4 created 14 no-zone reservations RS-1018..RS-1031; availability any={"available":true,"capacity":17,"booked":14,"remaining":3} garden={"available":true,"capacity":4,"booked":0,"remaining":4}' and 'R4 garden booking after all tables taken: buttonDisabled=false → RS-1032' (all test reservations cancelled afterwards). Note: zone-less ones were created by clearing the hidden zone field, which equals what admin phone bookings store
suggestedFix: Count zone-less holding reservations against every zone (e.g. zone check = min(zoneTables - zoneBooked, totalTables - allBooked)), or assign a zone/table at creation time

title: Reservation capacity ignores party size: a party of 40 in the garden (4 tables x 6 seats) is accepted and consumes only 1 table

title: Unverified guest checkout data can attach a new email to an existing phone-only customer, and email-OTP login then resolves to that customer
where: packages/core/src/customer/index.ts:139 upsertGuestCustomer (if (!existing.email && email) patch.email = email - email from an unauthenticated guest form is written onto the existing customer matched by phone) + :96 verifyOtp (email target looks up customers by email); reached from packages/modules/booking/src/services/bookings.ts:142 (guest booking passes the typed phone+email)
steps: Code-path review only (not executed): a guest booking typed with an existing customer's phone and a different email updates that customer's email; a later email OTP login with that email would sign into that customer record
expected: Guest forms never modify identity fields (email/phone) of an existing customer; a contact email supplied by a guest is stored on the booking/order only, and identity fields change only after OTP verification of the new value
actual: Per code, the existing customer row gains the unverified email, and verifyOtp(email) maps that email to the same customer id
evidence: Code: core/customer/index.ts lines 131-141 (lookup by phone, then patch.email = email when empty) and line 96 (email OTP → customers.email); booking guest path bookings.ts:142. Not reproduced at runtime on purpose
suggestedFix: Do not patch email/phone in upsertGuestCustomer (store contact details on the booking/order instead), or only fill identity fields after OTP verification; consider separate verified/unverified email columns
